mapper.select: SELECT menu_id, parent_menu_id, menu_code, menu_name, menu_path, sort_order, active FROM menu ORDER BY sort_order, menu_id

SELECT m.menu_id, m.parent_menu_id, m.menu_code, m.menu_name, m.menu_path, m.sort_order, CASE WHEN rm.role_id IS NULL THEN FALSE ELSE rm.can_read END AS can_read, CASE WHEN rm.role_id IS NULL THEN FALSE ELSE rm.can_write END AS can_write FROM menu m LEFT JOIN role_menu rm ON rm.menu_id = m.menu_id AND rm.role_id = #{roleId} WHERE m.active = TRUE ORDER BY m.sort_order, m.menu_id

SELECT m.menu_id, m.parent_menu_id, m.menu_code, m.menu_name, m.menu_path, m.sort_order, TRUE AS can_read, CASE WHEN MAX(CASE WHEN rm.can_write = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS can_write FROM employee_role er JOIN `role` r ON r.role_id = er.role_id AND r.active = TRUE JOIN role_menu rm ON rm.role_id = er.role_id AND rm.can_read = TRUE JOIN menu m ON m.menu_id = rm.menu_id AND m.active = TRUE WHERE er.employee_id = #{employeeId} GROUP BY m.menu_id, m.parent_menu_id, m.menu_code, m.menu_name, m.menu_path, m.sort_order ORDER BY m.sort_order, m.menu_id

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM employee e JOIN employee_role er ON er.employee_id = e.employee_id JOIN `role` r ON r.role_id = er.role_id AND r.active = TRUE JOIN role_menu rm ON rm.role_id = er.role_id JOIN menu m ON m.menu_id = rm.menu_id AND m.active = TRUE WHERE e.employee_id = #{employeeId} AND e.active = TRUE AND m.menu_code = #{menuCode} AND ( (#{writePermission} = TRUE AND rm.can_write = TRUE) OR (#{writePermission} = FALSE AND rm.can_read = TRUE) )
